last_good_saves.name: Stable Dashboard — Reset Cycles Works
last_good_saves.note: Exact stable current app target. Pause/Resume stable, Reset Cycles button works, instant Cycle 1 repaint works, engine state preserved.

meaning: Permanent launchers open the current app shell first. The current shell loads the newest current map and then opens the current Route Guardian loader. This pointer change also lets the discovery ZIP exporter load from the outer current app shell.
